shortDescription: Manage Layer-3 interfaces on Ruckus ICX 7000 series switches

options.name: aggregate
options.description: List of Layer-3 interfaces definitions. Each of the entry in aggregate list should define name of interface C(name) and a optional C(ipv4) or C(ipv6) address.

options.name: check_running_config
options.description: Check running configuration. This can be set as environment variable. Module will use environment variable value(default:True), unless it is overridden, by specifying it as module parameter.

options.name: ipv4
options.description: IPv4 address to be set for the Layer-3 interface mentioned in I(name) option. The address format is <ipv4 address>/<mask>, the mask is number in range 0-32 eg. 192.168.0.1/24

options.name: ipv6
options.description: IPv6 address to be set for the Layer-3 interface mentioned in I(name) option. The address format is <ipv6 address>/<mask>, the mask is number in range 0-128 eg. fd5d:12c9:2201:1::1/64.

options.name: mode
options.description: Specifies if ipv4 address should be dynamic/advertise to ospf/not advertise to ospf. This should be specified only if ipv4 address is configured and if it is not secondary IP address.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the Layer-3 interface to be configured eg. GigabitEthernet0/2, ve 10, ethernet 1/1/1

options.name: replace
options.description: Replaces the configured primary IP address on the interface.

options.name: secondary
options.description: Specifies that the configured address is a secondary IP address. If this keyword is omitted, the configured address is the primary IP address.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the Layer-3 interface configuration. It indicates if the configuration should be present or absent on remote device.
